title: Toy Blast
notes:
A delicious update is in the hive!

The bees are hard at work making honey, but something seems a little suspicious in the hive! One sneaky toy has put on a bee costume to get a taste of that sweet honey. Buzz into this playful update and see if the bees can spot the impostor!

Be sure to update to the latest version of Toy Blast for the newest content. Every 2 weeks, we bring you 50 NEW LEVELS!

Come and have fun!
